newsitem.title: GREECE: DECISION ON GREEK FRN COUPONS WAS TAKEN ON NOV 12 SAYS OFFICIAL.
newsitem.headline: DECISION ON GREEK FRN COUPONS WAS TAKEN ON NOV 12 SAYS OFFICIAL.

text.p: A controversial decision by the finance ministry to base the refixing of FRN coupons on the benchmark 12-month T-bill rate of 12 percent was taken on November 12, not November 14, a high-level finance ministry official told Reuters.
A monetary source told Reuters on Thursday that the finance ministry decided to cut the 12-month T-bill rate to 12 percent from 12.30 percent effective November 12.
The written terms of Greek FRNs state that the refixing of coupons is based on the prevailing benchmark 12-month T-bill rate three business days prior to the payment day.
Market talk that the decision had been taken on November 12 but the decree was actually signed on November 14 could not be confirmed.
FRN coupons are based on the benchmark rate and a fixed spread over it. The refixing of coupons on some outstanding FRNs is due today. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
